data.name: Parasailing
data.headline: Parasailing age 5+, Observers age 2+ • Available Daily
data.description: Soar above the Waikiki coastline with customizable parasailing adventures, offering breathtaking views of Diamond Head and the island’s pristine waters. Choose from three flight options for an unforgettable experience led by expert guides ensuring safety and enjoyment for all.
data.highlights:
- Customizable flight options: 600ft, 800ft, or 1000ft
- Flight duration varies from 4 to 10 minutes
- Expert guides ensure a safe and exciting experience
- No experience required; suitable for ages 5+ (minimum 50 lbs)
data.itinerary:
- **Departure:** Check in 30 minutes prior at Kewalo Harbor.
- **Flight options:** Choose between 600ft, 800ft, or 1000ft parasailing heights.
- **Flight duration:** Enjoy 4-10 minutes in the air based on your chosen height.
- **Views:** Soar above Waikiki Beach, capturing panoramic views of Diamond Head.
data.duration: 1-hour total tour with 4-10 minutes parasailing time

meeting_point.address: 1025 Ala Moana Blvd, (Slip F6) Honolulu, HI US 96814

data.what_is_included:
Parasailing equipment and harness

data.cancellation_summary: Cancellations allowed up to 24 hours before departure
data.cancellation_notes: Guests may cancel up to 24 hours prior to the tour start time for a full refund. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the tour are non-refundable. This policy applies to all clients and customers who book with us, regardless of the reason for cancellation.
data.booking_notes:
##Waivers
**Please make sure to sign a waiver before you arrive.**
[Start here](https://mono.wherewolf.co.nz/8ah65p). 

You may only sign waivers for yourself and individuals for whom you are the legal guardian. A valid photo ID must be uploaded with the waiver. If the participant is a minor or does not have a valid photo ID, a clear selfie may be uploaded as an alternative to the ID.

If you made this booking for multiple people, please forward this email to them or share the direct link: [https://mono.wherewolf.co.nz/8ah65p](https://mono.wherewolf.co.nz/8ah65p)

If you have previously signed this waiver for a different activity with our company, you are not required to sign it again—just let us know upon arrival.


##Recommended Preparation
Please check in 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time. Arrange your transportation in advance as it is not included. If you are driving a car, parking is available onsite for $2/hour. Payments can only be made via the app; there is no option to pay with cash or credit card directly. The vessel departs from Kewalo Harbor, just 10–15 minutes away from most Waikiki hotels. [See Driving Directions and location information here](https://gohawaiiwatersports.com/location/).

##For best experience of this Parasailing tour bring the following items:
- Change of clothes
- Camera
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Sunglasses
- Towel
- Tablets or patches to prevent seasickness if you are prone to getting seasick

##Included
- Equipment and harness for parasailing.
- Life vests.

##Not Included
- Pick up / Drop off. You will have to arrange for transportation yourself.
- Alcoholic drinks & food are not allowed.
- No restrooms on board.
- Fuel Surcharge to be paid upon arrival ($9.00 Per Person) 
- **Gratuities are not included in the tour price. While never expected, they are always appreciated as a way to recognize exceptional service.**
data.check_in_details: Check in 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time at Kewalo Harbor.
data.accessibility: Not suitable for pregnant women or those in poor health
data.special_requirements:
- Children must be at least 5 years old and weigh a minimum of 50 pounds.
- All participants must sign a waiver before boarding.
data.restrictions:
- Activities are weather dependent.
- Not suitable for pregnant women or those in poor health.
- No bananas are allowed onboard due to superstition.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
- Activities not suitable for pregnant women.
- Notify the operator of any medical conditions in advance.
- Safety equipment, including life vests, is provided and mandatory.
data.disclaimers:
- A $7 fuel charge per person applies.
- Parking is available onsite for $1/hour at Kewalo Basin Harbor.
- Events may be rescheduled or canceled due to weather conditions.
- Participants should avoid flying for 24 hours after diving activities.
data.faqs:
- **Is transportation included?** No, guests must arrange their own transportation. Parking is available for $1/hour.
- **Are restrooms available on board?** No, there are no restrooms on the vessel.
- **Is there a weight limit for parasailing?** Participants must weigh at least 50 pounds.
- **What happens in case of bad weather?** Tours may be rescheduled or canceled for safety reasons.
